product.name: Monoprice 120-Watt Rotary Resistance Speaker Volume Control
product.description: This 120‑Watt Speaker Volume Control features audiophile sound quality, with virtually no high‑end or low‑end roll‑off. It has a non‑shorting design, which prevents amplifier damage, and color‑coded, right‑angle, solderless speaker terminals with easy top termination. It uses a 12‑position switch, which offers a total of 36dB attenuation, with Off, two 6dB, seven 3dB, and full on settings. The package includes white, almond, and ivory plastic inserts and knobs.
